cc-release-watch: changelog fetch limits

The weekly watch died with spawnSync /bin/sh ENOBUFS once the Claude Code CHANGELOG reached 838 KB. This PR fetches the raw file instead of base64 through --jq .content.

01 / Which path survives a given size

PathPayload through the pipeResult

Limits: execSync default maxBuffer 1 MiB; GitHub contents API returns base64 content only for files up to 1 MB and serves the raw media type up to 100 MB; the fix sets maxBuffer to 128 MiB. Base64 size is 4/3 of the file plus a newline every 60 characters, as GitHub sends it.

02 / The pin

tests/integration/test-cc-release-watch-large-changelog.sh runs the real script from a temp root against a stub gh serving a 2 MB changelog. Old code: exit 1 with ENOBUFS. New code: 2 versions parsed, snapshot written.
